name: @avlo/py-build
description: AVLO Python runtime toolchain: forked-Pyodide build (docker/fork.Dockerfile via `avlo-build fork`) + artifact pack/verify/stage/publish via the uv-run `avlo-build` CLI (src/avlo_py_build). Turbo owns the pipeline DAG (root `pnpm py:board`), fork build included; the recipes loop stays a manual node/bash driver until its replatform phase and never runs in Turbo/CI.

scripts.py:census: uv run avlo-build census --check && uv run avlo-build verify-groups && uv run avlo-build verify-pytree
